name: Kitchen
fixed: Wall shared with dining room, load path unconfirmed
description: Galley kitchen, 1948 ranch. Cabinets run both long walls with a 38-inch aisle. Fridge sits at the dining end and its door swings into the only walkway. One pendant centered on the ceiling, no under-cabinet light. The 32-inch doorway to the dining room is in the shared wall. Laminate counters, painted flat-panel cabinets from a 1990s refresh, original oak floor continues from the living room.
